text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off.
I spotted Daiwa Scarlet in front of the school gate.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm really looking forward to lunch with Spe-san♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I hope you like it!
choice_data_list: Are you two going out together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer............-san.
Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hello! I'm actually about to have lunch
with Scarlet-san~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Since we're both here, would you like to join me if you'd like!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you say so, Senpai,
then I don't mind at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment she says that, Daiwa Scarlet leans in close and whispers to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I think you know this, but we're in front of our seniors.
I won't tolerate your usual shenanigans...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter, you two?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's nothing at all♪
Well then, Senpai, let's head out right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Impressed by how quickly Daiwa Scarlet changed her tune,
I decided to just go along with her.

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
"‘Mountain Highs! Wholesome Hamburg Steak Platter’
for three, thank you for waiting—!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is the one! My personal recommendation!
Mmm, doesn't it look delicious~?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I see... So this is what Spe-san's recommendations amount to...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A super gigantic hamburger steak, a huge heap of sautéed vegetables,
and a mountain of rice completely took over the table...
choice_data_list: So "the mountain" was meant literally, huh...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the fooood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Special Week eagerly begins digging in,
Daiwa Scarlet leans over and whispers to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Leaving behind food that my senpai recommended right in front of them would be terribly rude...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You better brace yourself too...!
I'm definitely gonna savor every single bite...!
choice_data_list: Let's wolf it down before fullness kicks in...!
Starting with the vegetables, let's tackle this systematically...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, good strategy.
Let's decide this in a flash of pure speed...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Th... thank you for the meal...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wah! Scarlet and the others cleaned their plates!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: To finish eating before me, you must have really loved it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-It was... delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal!
It was wickedly delicious today too~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, perhaps because I ate in such a hurry, my stomach felt unsettled,
and I headed back to the academy clutching my belly...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, good plan.
Aid digestion as much as possible, and finish it all down to the last bite!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal!
Haaah~, it was crazy delicious as always~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'm sorry!
I'm the only one who finished eating so quickly—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Spe-san. You eat so cleanly.
But we're down to our last bite too—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *Munch!*

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you... for the meal...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Scarlet and the others finished everything too!
I'm so glad they liked it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-It was... very delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, even after returning to the academy and night falling,
there wasn't the slightest sign of getting hungry.
